svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 180 x 320 mm, 3 mm aluminium. Front view is the face the box sits on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 100 x 150 mm, 6 mm corner radius, 65 to 215 mm up: drill the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners 12 mm, cut between with a jigsaw, file straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots 3 x 15 mm at 51 mm each side, centred 20 and 270 mm up:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain drill 3 mm, file square. The band goes through these.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V-block screws 4.5 mm at 18 mm each side, 20 and 270 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink from the front so the screw heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug screws 5.5 mm at 62 mm each side, 31 and 249 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate clip screws 5.5 mm at 65 mm each side, 275 and 305 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shield screws: drill 3.3 mm and tap M4 at 84 mm each side, 80 and 220 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wall holes 6.5 mm at 40 mm each side 305 mm up, 75 mm each side 12 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole and edge; round the corners to about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the V-blocks, lugs and clips on it and look through each hole.
